title: DC-area forecast: Some showers around today, mostly beautiful Sunday and Labor Day
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Temperatures move through the 70s this morning before slightly less muggy afternoon highs in the low to mid-80s. Lots of clouds with some showers and a rumble chance focused about 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., especially southwestern and southern parts of the area or south of that.

What’s next? Lower humidity returns tomorrow and holds through Labor Day, with mostly clear skies and pleasant temperatures. Readings start to climb by Tuesday and Wednesday, with rain chances returning Wednesday evening. Humidity becomes more noticeable by Thursday as highs near 90.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: The muggiest and cloudiest day of the long weekend, but brighter skies and drier air are on the doorstep. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Saturday): Considerable clouds with glimpses of sun as temperatures climb into the low to mid-80s. Humidity gradually decreases (dew points start near 70 before falling into the 60s this afternoon). Some showers and rumbles are possible, especially south and west of DC. Farther north may stay dry. Light winds from the north-northeast hover around 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: A few spotty showers may linger during the evening, again especially south and west, with mostly cloudy skies. Should be mostly dry overnight as lows dip to the mid- to upper 60s with clearing skies toward morning. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Sunday): Mostly sunny and nice as humidity and heat ease, with highs reaching the upper 70s to low 80s and dew points staying in the low 60s. Light winds from the northeast around 10 mph. Confidence: Medium-High 😎 Nice Day!

Tomorrow night: Mostly clear skies prevail and it’s not too humid, but perhaps feeling a touch sticky overnight. Lows dip into the low to mid-60s, with a patch or two of fog possible. Confidence: Medium-High

A look ahead

A pleasant Labor Day is expected with mostly clear to partly cloudy skies, highs again in the upper 70s to low 80s, and comfortable humidity (dew points mainly in the upper 50s to low 60s). It should be a great day to enjoy the extra day off and get outside! Confidence: Medium

The pleasant stretch continues Tuesday, with relatively low humidity and highs in the low to mid-80s under partly to mostly sunny skies. Temperatures trend up Wednesday, with highs potentially eyeing 90, while humidity begins to creep back in. A shower chance could also return Wednesday evening. Confidence: Medium

By Thursday, highs again reach for 90 as humidity continues to build, with dew points rising into the upper 60s and low 70s. We’ll have to see if a shower or storm chance enters the picture. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for September 5

Torrential rains tied to the 1935 Labor Day Hurricane produced record rainfall and widespread flooding, while in 1979 Tropical Storm David brought wind damage, flooding, and even tornadoes to the region.
